statement: There are 12 irreducible nodal plane cubics through eight general points, hence 12 irreducible rational plane cubics for those general point data.

source.location: Theorem III, table column D, row k=0, author preprint printed page 22
source.version: Author-hosted 30-page preprint, Theorem III, printed page 22

notes:
Cuspidal and reducible cubics do not occur for eight general points. The generic nodal specialization does not classify exceptional eight-point configurations.
